title: Origin: Variable Golem
description: Adds the Variable Golem origin to your world
body:
This datapack adds the Variable Golem origin, a special golem that can be built from multiple different variables for lots of variety.

Made for the 2025 Origins: Cog in the Wheel jam
## Abilities
### Battery
Instead of food, you must maintain your battery charge to survive. When it is low, you will be unable to sprint, and when it is depleted, you will slowly take damage.
### Variable
When selecting this origin for the first time, you may select a component from 3 categories to make up your body with: An Elemental Core, a Power Supply for your battery, and a Utility Hand.
## Variables
### Core Components
#### Flame Core
A core that grants you fire elemental abilities.
#### Aqua Core
A core that grants you water elemental abilities.
#### Thunder Core
A core that grants you lightning elemental abilities.
#### Frost Core
A core that grants you ice elemental abilities.
#### Nature Core
A core that grants you nature-based abilities.
### Power Supplies
#### Furnace
Recharge your battery slowly by consuming fuel.
#### Solar Panel
Recharge your battery through exposing yourself to sunlight.
#### Hydro Engine
Recharge your battery through water flow.
#### Crystal Matrix
Recharge and slow your battery through the use of amethyst crystals.
#### Lightning Capacitor
Recharge your battery through lightning strikes.
### Utility Hands
#### Drill Hand
Increases mining speed and allows you to mine natural stone as if your hand was a pickaxe.
#### Claimb Hand
Allows for climbing walls.
#### Piston Fist
Knocks enemies away when using melee attacks.
#### Crafting Hand
Allows for easy crafting, anywhere.
#### Pocket Hand
Adds additional storage options.
